verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's default Runbook, which attaches to every incident, assigns the incident opener to the Commander role and includes an "Add Task List" step. That covers the core of defined roles plus checklists. Runbooks can also be tailored to different situations and teams. missing for 10: no evidence of a comms-lead or other named roles beyond Commander, no detail on how task checklists are defined or tracked during response, no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, incidents carry defined roles (commander, comms lead) and task checklists so response stays coordinated under pressure

citations.quote: **Assign a Role**: Assigns whoever opened the incident to the Commander role.
The default Runbook will always have two default steps: Assign a Role... Add Task List
FireHydrant builds a Default Runbook for you that always attaches to every incident.
Standardize processes and tailor them for different situations, product areas, and teams, among other criteria
